questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe the shared responsibility model
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Customer identity responsibility: the cloud service model that leaves the most operational responsibility with the customer.
Customer data responsibility: the cloud provider is responsible for the physical datacenter.
Customer device responsibility: a cloud computing platform that provides services for compute, storage, networking, databases, AI, IoT, and more.
Customer identity responsibility: the customer remains responsible for accounts and identities used in the environment.
Customer data responsibility: the customer remains responsible for information and data stored in the cloud.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Customer data responsibility — the customer remains responsible for information and data stored in the cloud; and Customer identity responsibility — the customer remains responsible for accounts and identities used in the environment.
